confidence: generalized profile evidence with one shared parameter prior; conditional, not a causal probability
covariance: Shared-endpoint rounding plus Brownian drift scaled by observed nonnegative quota increments
estimate_policy: No particle-filter or constant-capacity estimates collected, transmitted or used
other_model_prices: assumed correct; include existing configured model/long-context prices
retention: durable per-account-cycle batches; replace same batch; no automatic expiry
